record.original_question: For the four-dimensional Brezis-Nirenberg Dirichlet problem -Delta u = lambda u + |u|^(2*-2)u in a bounded domain Omega subset of R^4 with u = 0 on partial Omega, do sign-changing solutions exist for every positive parameter lambda that belongs to the Dirichlet spectrum sigma(-Delta)?

evidence.quote: In dimension 4, the existence of sign-changing solutions was proved for every lambda > 0, lambda notin sigma(-Delta) ([16]).
Open question 3: when N = 4, lambda in sigma(-Delta), are there sign-changing solutions for every lambda > 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^4$ be a bounded smooth domain, and consider the Brezis–Nirenberg problem at the critical Sobolev exponent $2^* = \frac{2N}{N-2} = 4$ in dimension $N=4$:
$$
\begin{cases}
-\Delta u = \lambda u + |u|^{2}u & \text{in } \Omega,\\
u = 0 & \text{on } \partial\Omega,
\end{cases}
$$
where $\lambda > 0$ is a real parameter. Let $\sigma(-\Delta)$ denote the Dirichlet spectrum of $-\Delta$ on $\Omega$, i.e. the set of eigenvalues of $-\Delta$ acting on $H^1_0(\Omega)$. A weak solution $u \in H^1_0(\Omega)$ is called sign-changing if both $u^+ = \max(u,0)$ and $u^- = \max(-u,0)$ are nontrivial.

It is known that for every $\lambda > 0$ with $\lambda \notin \sigma(-\Delta)$ the above problem admits a sign-changing solution.

Question: For every $\lambda \in \sigma(-\Delta)$ with $\lambda > 0$, does the problem above admit a sign-changing solution?
artifact.status_search_result: Existing literature establishes the existence of sign-changing solutions to the 4D Brezis–Nirenberg problem for all positive $\lambda$ outside the Dirichlet spectrum. Recent work (e.g., constructions of bubbling solutions in dimensions 4 and 5) addresses concentration phenomena at eigenvalues but does not appear to settle the existence of sign-changing solutions for every $\lambda \in \sigma(-\Delta)$. No source was found resolving this case, so the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The Brezis-Nirenberg problem in 4D
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the Brezis–Nirenberg problem specifically in dimension 4, including sign-changing/bubbling solutions.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work in dimension 4 addresses bubbling and sign-changing solutions but the case lambda in the spectrum is not generally resolved.

status_evidence.title: Construction of bubbling solutions of the Brezis–Nirenberg problem in dimensions 4 and 5
status_evidence.snippet: Every eigenvalue of -Delta with Dirichlet boundary is a concentration value via Lyapunov–Schmidt reduction in dimensions N=4 and 5.
status_evidence.claim: Eigenvalues are concentration values, but a complete existence theory of sign-changing solutions for every lambda in the spectrum in dimension 4 is not established.
